activity.notes: Yi Seong-gye founded Joseon and reigned as its first king, Taejo, from 1392 to 1398. ATLAS uses his sovereign reign as the representative Activity.

sources.title: 태조
sources.citation_text: The Encyclopedia of Korean Culture identifies Taejo, originally named Yi Seong-gye, as the first king of Joseon and gives his reign as 1392–1398.
